title: Persona 4 Revival Reveals More Story and Characters
summary: Persona 4 Revival has received a new story trailer and additional character information, giving fans a closer look at the remake's world and cast.
content:
Persona 4 Revival has received a new story trailer, offering another look at the remake's setting, characters, and narrative direction.

The latest presentation returns players to Inaba and highlights the cast surrounding the game's mystery. The trailer focuses on the story and introduces additional details about the characters players will meet during the adventure.

SEGA and ATLUS have continued to reveal information about Persona 4 Revival through trailers and character materials. The latest information gives fans a closer look at the game's interpretation of Inaba and its characters.

The new material also highlights Kanji Tatsumi, one of the characters featured in the newly released information. The remake is continuing to build anticipation by gradually revealing more of its story and cast.

faq.question: What is Persona 4 Revival?
faq.answer: Persona 4 Revival is a remake of Persona 4 being developed by ATLUS.

faq.question: What was recently revealed?
faq.answer: A new story trailer and additional character information were released, providing more details about the setting and cast.

faq.question: Where does Persona 4 Revival take place?
faq.answer: The story is set around the town of Inaba.

faq.question: Who is Kanji Tatsumi?
faq.answer: Kanji Tatsumi is one of the characters featured in the latest official character information for Persona 4 Revival.
